feeds.title: The Fitnessista
feeds.description: My name is Gina. On this blog, I like to share some daily happenings, as well as quick, effective workouts and healthy recipes. The mission of my blog is to demonstrate that fitness and healthy eating doesn't have to be blah and boring.

feeds.title: Organize Yourself Skinny
feeds.description: Dedicated to helping busy people eat healthier and lose weight by combining calorie awareness with menu planning, freezer cooking, and others make head meal cooking strategies.

feeds.title: FIT4MOM Blog
feeds.description: From pregnancy workouts through postpartum and beyond, FIT4MOM offers fitness classes for moms at every workout level and stage of motherhood. Follow to get stories of motherhood for prenatal and postpartum wellness through fitness, nutrition, tips, tricks, and more.

feeds.title: Stay Fit Mom
feeds.description: All about balancing a healthy lifestyle, fitness, and being a mom. Follow to get recipes, workout routines, tips for eating healthy, and all things moms love.

feeds.title: Carrots'n'Cake » Fitness
feeds.description: Carrots 'N' Cake is where I share my love of food, staying fit, and living a healthy life. While I try to pack the most nutrients possible into each meal, I have a number of favorite foods that are not necessarily 'healthy,' but are still delicious and fun to eat.

feeds.title: The Healthy Foodie
feeds.description: Get inspired in the kitchen and adopt a healthy lifestyle: browse hundreds of nutritious, tasty and healthy recipes. Whether you are vegan, vegetarian, paleo or gluten-free, whatever your dietary reality is, cooking healthy meals doesn't have to boring or complicated!

feeds.title: A Fit Mom's Life Blog » Health and Fitness
feeds.description: A Fit Mom's Life is a Fitness, Health & Well-being blog for moms and women of all shapes. This is a good place for women to come for inspiration in their lives, and even for a good recipe every now and then.

feeds.title: Eating Made Easy » Weight Loss
feeds.description: I'm Amelia, a nutritionist, chef and mom who believes healthy eating should be simple and enjoyable, not stressful or overwhelming. I started this blog so I could answer your food questions, debunk nutrition myths, and offer practical tips & recipes that I hope will make your busy life easier. Know more about food that will help in your journey of weight loss.

feeds.title: Clean And Delicious » Weight Loss
feeds.description: I'm Dani. I'm a Health, Wellness & Weight Loss Coach, Mom of two, and the Founder of Clean & Delicious. There is a healthy and sustainable way to lose weight and keeping it off for a long time. Find tips and advice for weigh loss in this section.

feeds.title: Lyndi Cohen Blog
feeds.description: This isn't like other 'health' blogs. I cut through nutrition noise, and wellness wankery and keep it real. Get real health advice you can trust. I'm Lyndi Cohen. A dietitian, TV Nutritionist and author who stands up against diet nonsense.

feeds.title: Fit Found Me » Weight Loss
feeds.description: I'm Stephanie and after struggling for years, I finally lost over 35 lbs after 40. I started this website to share everything I did then and what I am currently doing to keep the weight off, now over 10 years later! I enjoy sharing my favorite easy, quick healthy recipes, fitness and anything else that can help you lose weight and reach your healthy lifestyle goals. I invite you to read through the site, sign up for weekly tips, reach out if you have questions and even join one of my challenges to get support through your own weight loss journey.

feeds.title: Lose Weight By Eating » Weight Loss
feeds.description: I'm Audrey, 4 times best-selling cookbook author and lose weight by eating recipe developer. I've published 100's of healthy recipes and weight loss plans. Originally started as a weight loss blog, Lose Weight By Eating has lots of weight loss tips and tricks.

feeds.title: The Healthy Mummy » Weight-Loss
feeds.description: Healthy Mommy is a health and weight loss plan designed exclusively for moms to empower them to live healthier life after having children. Find weight loss tips, advice, diet and health plans and more!

feeds.title: Belly Laugh Living
feeds.description: On our blog we share fat cutting tips, recipes, and kitchen hacks we've learned along our weight loss journey. Belly Laugh Living is a blog by Mom/Daughter team developing step-by-step recipes that are sometimes spicy, always delicious, cutting the fat & boosting the flavor.

feeds.title: Runs for Cookies
feeds.description: In August 2009, I went on a mission to lose 100 pounds. I lost 125 pounds in 16 months, and now I'm doing my best to keep it off. Unwilling to give up my love affair with cookies, I became a runner along the way, hoping to achieve a nice balance.
